SELECT DISTINCT sdn.id, sdn.code, sdn.source_code AS soCode, sdn.seller_name, sdn.warehouse_id, sdn.warehouse_name, sdn.customer_name, sdn.approve_status, sdn.create_time FROM so_delivery_notice sdn LEFT JOIN so_delivery_notice_detail sdnd ON sdn.id = sdnd.main_id AND sdnd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE sdn.is_deleted = FALSE AND sdn.invalid_status = FALSE AND sdn.approve_status = 'approve'
AND sdnd.sku_no = #{skuNo}
AND sdn.code ILIKE concat('%', #{code}::text ,'%')
ORDER BY sdn.create_time

-- b2b销售订单冻结 select sd.sku_id, sd.sku_no, si.virtual_warehouse_id, si.warehouse_id, 'soInfo' as source_type, si.id as source_id, si.code as source_code, sd.id as source_detail_id, COALESCE(sd.frozen_time,sd.create_time) as bill_date, COALESCE(sd.frozen_time,sd.create_time) as trade_time, sd.frozen_qty as qty from so_info si inner join so_detail sd on si.id = sd.main_id and sd.is_deleted = false and sd.frozen_qty > 0 where si.is_deleted = false and si.virtual_warehouse_id != '' union all -- 发货通知单冻结 select * from ( select sdnd.sku_id, sdnd.sku_no, sdn.virtual_warehouse_id, sdn.warehouse_id, 'soDeliveryNotice' as source_type, sdn.id as source_id, sdn.code as source_code, sdnd.id as source_detail_id, sdn.create_time as bill_date, sdn.create_time as trade_time, case when sdn.approve_status = 'approve' then sdnd.picking_qty else sdnd.last_picking_qty end as qty from so_delivery_notice sdn inner join so_delivery_notice_detail sdnd on sdn.id = sdnd.main_id and sdnd.is_deleted = false and sdn.virtual_warehouse_id != '' and sdn.invalid_status = false where sdn.is_deleted = false ) as soDelivery where soDelivery.qty > 0 -- 加工单出库(发货通知单下推) union all select md.sku_id, md.sku_no, sdn.virtual_warehouse_id, sdn.warehouse_id, 'machineInfo' as source_type, mi.id as source_id, mi.code as source_code, md.id as source_detail_id, mi.approve_time as bill_date, mi.approve_time as trade_time, md.qty as qty from machine_info mi inner join machine_detail md on md.main_id = mi.id and md.is_deleted = false and mi.approve_status = 'approve' and mi.source_type = 'soDeliveryNotice' and md.qty > 0 inner join so_delivery_notice_detail sdnd on sdnd.id = md.source_detail_id and sdnd.is_deleted = false inner join so_delivery_notice sdn on sdn.id = sdnd.main_id and sdn.is_deleted = false and sdn.virtual_warehouse_id != '' where mi.is_deleted = false -- 加工单出库(销售订单下推) union all select md.sku_id, md.sku_no, si.virtual_warehouse_id, si.warehouse_id, 'machineInfo' as source_type, mi.id as source_id, mi.code as source_code, md.id as source_detail_id, mi.approve_time as bill_date, mi.approve_time as trade_time, md.qty as qty from machine_info mi inner join machine_detail md on md.main_id = mi.id and md.is_deleted = false and mi.approve_status = 'approve' and mi.source_type = 'soInfo' and md.qty > 0 inner join machine_ref_so mrs on md.id = mrs.machine_detail_id and mi.id = mrs.machine_id and mrs.is_deleted = false inner join so_info si on si.id = mrs.so_id and si.is_deleted = false and si.virtual_warehouse_id != '' where mi.is_deleted = false --直接调拨单出库 union all select tid.sku_id, tid.sku_no, sdn.virtual_warehouse_id, sdn.warehouse_id, 'transferInfo' as source_type, ti.id as source_id, ti.code as source_code, tid.id as source_detail_id, ti.approve_time as bill_date, ti.approve_time as trade_time, tid.qty as qty from transfer_info ti inner join transfer_info_detail tid on ti.id = tid.main_id and tid.is_deleted = false and ti.approve_status = 'approve' and tid.qty > 0 inner join so_delivery_notice_detail sdnd on sdnd.id = tid.source_detail_id and sdnd.is_deleted = false inner join so_delivery_notice sdn on sdn.id = sdnd.main_id and sdn.is_deleted = false and sdn.virtual_warehouse_id != '' and tid.out_warehouse_id = sdn.warehouse_id where ti.is_deleted = false union all -- 销售出库单出库 select sod.sku_id, sod.sku_no, sdn.virtual_warehouse_id, sdn.warehouse_id, 'soOutstock' as source_type, so.id as source_id, so.code as source_code, sod.id as source_detail_id, so.approve_time as bill_date, so.approve_time as trade_time, sod.actual_qty as qty from so_outstock so inner join so_outstock_detail sod on so.id = sod.main_id and sod.is_deleted = false and so.approve_status = 'approve' and sod.actual_qty > 0 inner join so_delivery_notice_detail sdnd on sdnd.id = sod.source_detail_id and sdnd.is_deleted = false inner join so_delivery_notice sdn on sdn.id = sdnd.main_id and sdn.is_deleted = false and sdn.virtual_warehouse_id != '' and sod.warehouse_id = sdn.warehouse_id where so.is_deleted = false

SELECT sdn.id, sdnd.id as detailId, sdn.source_id as soId, sdn.source_code as soCode, sdnd.sku_id as skuId, sdnd.sku_no as skuNo, sdnd.platform_sku_no as platformSkuNo, sdnd.delivery_qty as deliveryQty from so_delivery_notice sdn LEFT JOIN so_delivery_notice_detail sdnd on sdn.id = sdnd.main_id where sdn.is_deleted = false and sdnd.is_deleted = false and sdnd.id in
#{id}
